title: How to prepare access before moving day
excerpt: A practical access check helps the moving team arrive with the right plan, protect shared spaces and keep handover time under control.

body.heading: Walk the route before the van arrives

paragraphs.text: Trace the full journey from the nearest safe loading point to each room. Note narrow turns, low entrances, shared corridors and any surfaces that need protection.
If the route crosses a reception, concierge desk or shared entrance, confirm who can grant access and when they will be available.

body.heading: Reserve the parts you can control

paragraphs.text: Arrange lift access, parking permissions and building time slots early. Keep confirmation details together so they can be shared with the move coordinator before moving day.
Move loose items away from doorways, identify anything that cannot use the main route and make sure keys or access codes are with the person meeting the team.
